name: HydroGraph Clean Power Inc.
summary: HydroGraph Clean Power Inc., established in 2017 and based in Toronto, Canada, focuses on the global development and marketing of proprietary technologies. These innovations enable the production of high-quality graphene, hydrogen, syngas, methane, and other related products. The company was formerly known as Carbon-2D Graphene Inc. until it adopted its current name in March 2021.
